title: Wireshark or tcpdump: Capturing and Analysing Network Traffic
excerpt: Two essential packet tools that work well together. tcpdump captures traffic from the command line almost anywhere; Wireshark provides deep, visual analysis.
verdict: Wireshark is the better tool for detailed analysis and for learning, thanks to its graphical interface and protocol dissectors. tcpdump is indispensable for capturing on remote or headless servers; a common workflow is to capture with tcpdump and analyse the file in Wireshark.
